parts.html: The K-14 standard model is a contemporary solution for interiors where kitchen furniture becomes part of a unified architectural space. The straight layout with an island, the warm beige palette, and the mixed fronts create a harmonious minimalist composition.

The understated solid-color finish highlights the geometry of the cabinets while preserving the visual unity of the kitchen. Beige tones bring softness to the interior and pair well with natural wood, light stone, decorative plaster, and contemporary finishing materials.

The K-14 model features a straight main run of cabinets and a kitchen island. This layout makes it possible to separate kitchen tasks: storage and built-in appliances are placed along the wall, while the island serves as an additional surface for food prep and everyday tasks.

With a total length of 7.6 linear meters, the kitchen offers ample space for cabinets and work zones. The model is well suited to modern apartments, spacious condos, and private homes with open-plan layouts.

A distinctive design feature is the combination of two types of fronts. The upper cabinets are made of acrylic-faced MDF board, and the lower ones of HPL-faced MDF board. Using different materials within a single color scheme preserves a clean aesthetic while giving the furniture an individual character.
A compact laminate countertop completes the minimalist composition. The carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard, and the design accommodates built-in appliances.

FREE FOLD Hafele lift-up mechanisms make the upper cabinets easy to open. Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges ensure the doors close smoothly, while Muller Box Profi Line drawers make it easy to organize kitchen utensils and accessories.
Cabinet handles are included with this model. A cargo pull-out is not included.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and makes custom kitchens for apartments, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-14 standard model can be adapted to the specific dimensions of your room, taking into account the location of utility connections and built-in appliances, as well as the client’s storage preferences.
When developing a custom design, the size of the kitchen island, the cabinet arrangement, and the placement of work surfaces can be adjusted to suit the room.
We offer comprehensive services for kitchen furniture design, material selection, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
At the client’s request, the kitchen can also be fitted with a sink, appliances, a range hood, and plumbing fixtures.
